entries.source: StA St. Gallen, Zürcher Abt. 9., 1294 X 15
entries.german:
Heinrich von Schönstein verspricht dem Abt von St. Gallen, ihm die Burg Neuravensburg jederzeit zurückzugeben und sie ihm offenzuhalten.

In gotes namen amen. Ich Hainrich der ritter von Scho eninstain 1 kunde || allen den, die dise gegenwrtigen hantvesti iemer ane gesehint alde ho er||rint lesin, aine gelo vbsami aller der dinge, so dar ane geschriben stat. || Ir sulent allesamint fur aine rehtun warheit wissen, daz ich vergihe a) mit dierre hantuesti, daz ich die burch ze der Niwen Rauinspurch 2, die mir min herre abbet Will(hel)m von sante Gallin 3 in gv oten vnde in ganzen vnde in iemer werden triwen bevolhin b) hat, die selben burch von ime enphangen han mit dem gedinge, daz ich ime die vorgenanten burch zallen citen hivte morne vnde zallen stunden vnde sinen nachkomen, ob er inware, mit eren antwrten sol an allin furzvg vnde ane wider rede, noch en sol ime noch sinen nachkomen weder en phandes wis noch mit dekainen anderen listen si vor behaben mit niwete. Vnde daz ich minem herren abbet Will(hel)m vnde sinen nachkomen allez daz, daz an dierre hantvesti stat, staete han, des gib ich ime zainer sicherhait minen o ehaimen hern Růdolfen vnde Gerien von Willer 4 mit mir vnverschaidenlichen ze tro estern vnde ze wern ime vnde sinen nachkomen, dise burch wider ze antwrtinne zallen citen, alse da vorgeschriben stat. Vnde ich herre H. von Scho eninstain vnde wir herre Rud. vnde Gerie von Willer sezzin c) vns ze wern vnde ze tro estern vnserme hern abbet Will(hel)m alliz daz, daz an dierre hantuesti geschriben stat, mit gv oten triwen ze laistenne zallen citen ane alle gevarde, vnde sweren dez ze den hailigon alle drie vnuirschaidenliche d) vnde geben ime dar zv o zainimer e) ewigen vrkunde dise hantvesti besigelt mit vnser aellir drier isigel. Diz beschach ze sante Gallin, do man zalte von gotez geburte M°CC°LXXXX°IIII° jare, an dem nahesten vritage vor sante Gallin tult, indict. VIII a. Da ze gegene waren dise gezivge: graue Rud., graue Hug vnde graue H. die gebrůdere 5 vnde graue Will(hel)m von Montfort 6, herre H. von Griezzenberc 7, Egel. von Rosenberc 8 vnde herre H. vnde herre Burch. de vo egte von Wartinse 9 vnde ander erbere livte genv oge.

entries.english:
Heinrich von Schönstein promises the abbot of St Gall that he will return Neuravensburg Castle to him at any time and keep it open to him.

In God’s name, amen. I, Heinrich, knight von Schönstein, make known to all who see or hear this present charter that I acknowledge by this document that I have received from my lord, Abbot Wilhelm of St Gall, the castle of Neuravensburg, which he entrusted to me in good and complete confidence and for all time, on condition that I must return the aforesaid castle to him and his successors at any time—today, tomorrow, or whenever—with honor, without evasion or objection. I may not retain it from him or his successors as a pledge or by any other device.

To ensure that I faithfully observe everything written in this charter for my lord Abbot Wilhelm and his successors, I appoint my kinsmen Rudolf and Gerie von Willer jointly with me as sureties and guarantors to return the castle at any time, as written above. I, Heinrich von Schönstein, and we, Rudolf and Gerie von Willer, jointly undertake to perform everything written in this charter for our lord the abbot and his successors faithfully at all times and without deceit. All three of us swear this together on the holy relics. As everlasting proof, we give him this charter sealed with the seals of all three of us.

This was done at St Gall on the Friday nearest the feast of St Gall, in the year of the Lord 1294, indiction 8. Present were Count Rudolf, Count Hugo and Count Heinrich, brothers; Count Wilhelm von Montfort; Lord Heinrich von Griessenberg; Egelolf von Rosenberg; Lord Heinrich and Lord Burkhard, advocates of Wartensee; and many other honorable people.

Seals: Three seals: the first missing; the second a fragment; the third missing.
